description: Implementation of SavingsProductReadPlatformService for retrieving savings product data from the database, including methods for retrieving all products, products for lookup, a single product by ID, and products filtered by currency or overdraft type. Contains inner classes for mapping database rows to data objects.

classes.name: SavingsProductReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to read savings product data from the database.

classes.name: SavingProductMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping ResultSet rows to SavingsProductData objects.

classes.name: SavingProductLookupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping ResultSet rows to lookup data of savings products.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all savings products available, filtered by deposit type and optionally by user office.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves savings products for lookup purposes, filtered by deposit type and optionally by user office.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single savings product by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookupByType
methods.description: Retrieves savings products for lookup filtered by whether they are overdraft types.

methods.name: retrieveAllForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves all savings products for a specific currency code.
